top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs a prediction (Kane and Mele) with the original experimental observation in HgTe quantum wells (Molenkamp), verified by nearly two decades of transport and spectroscopy work. The citation is narrowed to the 2D quantum spin Hall state and Z2 class, which these three can carry. The credit gap to Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and the 3D case are real caveats but are manageable through the wording. P002 (optical lattice clocks) is a well-verified invention but is supported by only two members, and I rank it second. No award is the weakest option because a mature, experimentally confirmed discovery is available.
